digest.component_or_area: code-review gate, plan-review gate, model configuration resolution
propositions: four code-review steps (base, round_a, round_b, coach) inherit a single cfg.model without declaring per-step model classes, preventing per-pass model selection across providers
a single REBAR_LLM_MODEL environment variable cannot express the required mapping of frontier-class models (opus) for Pass-1 and standard-class models (sonnet) for Pass-2/Pass-4

the verifier downgrade (to sonnet for Pass-2/Pass-4) is silently lost on non-default providers because resolve_verifier_model has zero production call sites and the resolve logic incorrectly conflates explicit operator choice with framework defaults
batch steps cannot use step-level model declarations because interpreter.py only reads model_ladder from the batch sub-dict, making single-rung model_ladder the required mechanism
runtime step model resolution is broken: declared model classes in code-review.yaml are ignored by the interpreter and every step inherits cfg.model regardless of per-step declarations
